materiality_boundary.description: A reversible or rescindable external effect, or one below the approved bound, is not a member.

irreversible_external_effect_above_appro.rationale: An external effect that cannot be rescinded cannot be traded off against a priority score.

material_information_barrier_breach.emergency_override_procedure: Head of Information Barriers may authorize a time-boxed exception with written rationale, recorded and reported to the forum within 24 hours.

materiality_boundary.description: A match on a de-listed or expired restricted-list entry with no live exposure is below the boundary.

material_information_barrier_breach.rationale: Information-barrier integrity is a condition of the dealer's registration; a material breach is irreversible on disclosure.

materiality_boundary.description: A documentation defect or other immaterial technical non-conformance does not enter C* solely because its source is statutory.

material_statutory_prohibition.rationale: A statutory prohibition whose breach is material to clients or to the dealer's registration is non-negotiable irrespective of its heat-map score.

materiality_boundary.description: An unauthorized act with no external effect and no reliance exposure is below the boundary.

unauthorized_authority_exercise.rationale: The system causing an effect it is not authorized to cause is an authorization failure, not a priority question.
